name: Quaternary Tree Volume Traversal
definition: A two-stage rasterization process distributed between CPU and GPU. The CPU divides object space using a quaternary tree to find intersections, and the GPU performs ray casting and shading.
summary: Quaternary Tree Volume Traversal is a CPU-GPU split rasterization method that uses a quaternary tree to cull empty space before GPU ray casting, optimizing performance for functionally defined objects.
